svg.text: SEEN FROM THE ROOM · D1 ON THE LEFT · BOOKCASE END ON THE RIGHT · TEAK FRAME TO THE DOOR HEAD (2503)
REEDED TEAK RAIL ON THE STUDY COUNTER LINE (570–610) · PLAIN WALL ABOVE · SIZES ARE ESTIMATES
After 'form-led details' — tall woven-linen panels held in a slim teak frame, lamps on the stiles
Recommended: your teak and long lines, softened by fabric; timeless, warm, quiet next to the bookcase
After your bed reference — copper-leaf panels in dark teak frames, so the wall and the bed back speak together
The richest — glows at night under warm light; best if the bed back uses the same leaf
After 'impactful details' — linen panels either side of one deep-framed teak panel with a carved sunburst grain
A single statement piece; the rest stays calm — works if nothing large hangs on this wall
